question: Who among the following presides over the meeting of the Council of Ministers in a state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chief Minister of the state**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Chief Minister is the **head of the Council of Ministers** in a state and presides over its meetings.
 
• The Chief Minister plays a pivotal role in shaping policies and ensuring coordination among ministers for governance.
 
• All major decisions of the Council of Ministers are deliberated and finalized under the leadership of the Chief Minister.
 
• As the executive authority of the state, the Chief Minister ensures the implementation of government policies and programs.
 
• The Governor appoints the Chief Minister, who is usually the leader of the majority party in the Legislative Assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Council of Ministers:**

 
 
• The Council of Ministers includes the Chief Minister, Cabinet Ministers, Ministers of State, and Deputy Ministers.
 
• It collectively exercises executive power and advises the Governor on various matters.
 
• It is responsible for the formulation and execution of policies in the state.
 
 
 
• **Governor:**
 
 
• The Governor is the constitutional head of the state and acts on the advice of the Council of Ministers.
 
• The Governor's role is largely ceremonial, but they play a key role in appointing the Chief Minister.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Assembly:**
 
 
• The Legislative Assembly is the primary law-making body in the state.
 
• The Chief Minister is usually the leader of the majority party in the Legislative Assembly.
 
• It is responsible for passing laws and budgets for the state.
 
 
 
• **Executive Authority:**
 
 
• The Chief Minister holds the real executive authority in the state.
 
• He/she is responsible for the day-to-day functioning of the state government.
